mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 53 degrees with overcast skies at the Verona Public Library and a moderate air quality index of 51. We are under a full moon tonight and although the ISS will pass overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is moving forward with an agenda for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, which includes proposals for the Ardent Glen addition, new survey maps on Jenna Drive, and a site plan for Milky Way. Additionally, residents are reminded that tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15th.

We have a packed schedule starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow features Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, mark your calendars for Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th.
The Verona Police Department reported an incident from October 15th, where a school bus driver was arrested for operating while impaired after reports of dangerous driving.
Enjoy the delicious Pumpkin Pecan flavor of the day today. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
